metadata.short_desc: Trim reply whitespace and send long replies as several chat bubbles
metadata.desc: Makes bot replies feel like a person typing: strips leading/trailing blank lines, splits long replies by CJK punctuation into several messages sent with a random delay, attaches interjections to the following sentence, attaches parenthetical stage directions to the following line, and drops brace-wrapped state markers such as {affection: 15}. Group/private toggles, per-session blacklist, private-chat typing indicator, code/quote protection, and fully tunable splitting rules.

enabled.description: Master switch (plugin does nothing when off)

trim_enable.description: Trim leading/trailing whitespace and blank lines

split_enable.description: Split replies by punctuation and newlines

blacklist.hint: Group id / user id / full session id, one per entry

typing_enable.description: Send a typing indicator before each follow-up in private chats
typing_enable.hint: Uses the OneBot extension action set_input_status (LLOneBot / NapCat); private chats only

typing_event_type.description: Typing status type (1 usually means typing)

split_chars.description: Split characters (cut after each of these)

drop_chars.description: Characters removed at the end of every message
drop_chars.hint: Defaults remove 。 and ！; ？ is kept. Add … to also drop trailing ellipses

min_text_len.description: Do not split when the whole reply is shorter than this (and has no newline)

line_split_min_len.description: A line shorter than this is sent as one message without punctuation splitting

min_segment_len.description: Punctuation-split fragments within one line shorter than this are attached to the next segment

tail_merge_len.description: Only extremely short lines (at most this many real characters) are merged into the next line instead of being sent alone
tail_merge_len.hint: Default 1 (only single-character lines merge). 0 = no merging at all, one line per message

max_segments.description: Maximum number of messages (the rest are merged into the last one)

strip_state_tags.description: Remove brace-wrapped state markers from replies

protect_code.description: Never split code blocks, lists, quotes or tables

protect_quotes.description: Do not split inside quotes or brackets
